en.title: Speleologist trapped in a cave, rescuers: "He is conscious"

en.summary: The Pope will undergo surgery at Gemelli Hospital to address a lung nodule discovered during routine medical examinations. The Vatican is reorganizing schedules and preparing for his recovery period.

stories.title: Sardegna, speleologo bloccato nella grotta: è stato estratto, è vivo

en.title: Sardinia, speleologist trapped in cave: he has been extracted, he is alive
en.summary: A 31-year-old speleologist named Luca Olmetto was successfully rescued from a cave in Sardinia after being trapped. The rescue operation required careful procedures due to extremely limited working space measuring approximately 1.5 meters.
